figures.title: Average the two conditional laws
figures.alt: A fair selector gives a discrete law μ₀ or a density h, each with weight one half. Their weighted sum is the marginal law.

figures.title: One conditional mean per observed group
figures.alt: Four equally likely outcomes with values 0,2,4,8 are grouped into the first and last pairs. Their conditional predictions are 1,1,6,6.

figures.title: A Gaussian chain after accounting for the middle variable
figures.alt: The chain X₁—X₂—X₃ has precision entry Θ₁₃=0. The first and third variables are conditionally independent given the middle variable, although their marginal covariance is 1.
